text: {"fixes":[{"element_id":"s35","problem":"The Noem hero photo at the top is a flat cartoon stand-in (dark block, white bar, pink square), so the heatmap is solid red across it. No listed picture covers it on this screen.","fix":"Redraw the image area x20..391, y0..280 as a dark night photo with the man's black tuxedo, white shirt and bow tie on the left and the woman in a pink dress on the right (#d8207f pink, dark #0b0d14 background). Remove the white bar and the flat magenta rectangle."},{"element_id":"s14","problem":"The Noem hero photo at y55..425 is a flat cartoon (faceless heads, brown hair blobs). The real screen is a photo, so the whole image area is red.","fix":"Replace the illustration with a closer stand-in. Use a dark #0a0c12 background, a man in a black tuxedo with a warm-toned face at x115..185, and a woman with long brown hair in a magenta-pink dress at x210..385. Give the heads oval skin tones (#c98a6a), and drop the flat hair-bar shapes."},{"element_id":"s20.e30","problem":"The top image of s20 (y0..160) is a blurry pink stand-in. The real one shows two dancers in pink and mauve on a stage floor. The back-button picture also has a purple artifact at its lower left.","fix":"Draw the image as a purple-magenta stage: dancers' legs in pale pink at x20..150 and x250..320, a floor gradient from #c05a8a to #7a3a7a, and a dark step area at the top right. Draw assets/s20.e30.png cleanly at x8, y20.2, 32x32 with no extra overlay."},{"element_id":"s20.e10","problem":"The bullet 'season 35 air on Tuesdays…' is 352.4 wide x 42 high where 348.2 x 43 is wanted. Bullet text is slightly too wide, and the bullet dots are smaller and set closer to the text than the real ones.","fix":"Reduce letter-spacing or font-size by about 1.2%, set the line-height to 24px, and make the bullet dots about 5px with a 40px text indent."},{"element_id":"s20.e20","problem":"The last paragraph is 375.3 wide x 90 high where 369.9 x 91 is wanted. It runs too wide, and 'Foxtrot.' is close to the edge.","fix":"Narrow the text by about 1.5% so the width is 369.9, keep the line-height at 24px so the height is 91, and set the block top at y603.4."},{"element_id":"s35.e07","problem":"The bold 'Bryon Noem' is at x288.9, w85.8, h18. The wanted rect is x284.6, w87.2, h19.1. The same text on s14 (s14.e17, s14.e18) and s64 (s64.e13) has the same error.","fix":"Shift the run 4px left to x284.6, widen it to 87.2 and set the height to 19.1. The preceding text 'Six months after photos of her husband' should end about 4px earlier."},{"element_id":"s35.e18","problem":"The TE Connectivity ad title 'TE Connectivity Leads AI' and 'Open' are drawn too bold and 2px too far left, and the logo box is offset. Text throughout the ad is heavier than the real one.","fix":"Use assets/s35.e18.art.png at x56, y557.4, 300.9x137.4 with nothing drawn over it. Set the title to regular weight (#222) starting at x77, and set 'Open' in blue #2a6cf0 at x268."},{"element_id":"s14","problem":"The Too Faced ad has a heavy logo script and a crude bottle, and the text is about 2px off.","fix":"Draw the 'Too Faced' script at about 22px, regular weight and italic, at x73, y722. Draw the bottle as a brown cylinder (#6b2f2b) with a black brush handle, x255..305."},{"element_id":"s64","problem":"The title and byline text is slightly wider and bolder than the real one, which causes red streaks in the heatmap. Body text 'Kristi Noem is stepping…' is about 1px off.","fix":"Reduce the title's letter-spacing by about 1% so 'Kristi Noem Files for Divorce' ends near x350. Keep the same weight as the real one, and move the body text 1px lower."}],"summary":"The mock is at 8.94 and the layout is mostly right. The largest remaining errors are the flat stand-in hero photos and the text that is still a bit too wide, which throws off the 'Bryon Noem' runs. This round should fix the hero images on s14, s20 and s35 and narrow the text so the few remaining data-el boxes land within 4px."}
